lines.text: At 4 PM, a rare guitar just vanished.
lines.say: At four P.M., a rare guitar just vanished.

lines.text: Smashed case. No cameras. Three people with a motive.
First, Jax, a rival guitarist: I was at the pier all day!
He even posted a selfie. 4:05 PM.
lines.say: He even posted a selfie. Four oh-five P.M.

lines.text: Then June, the clerk: I was scanning stock in the back.
The scanner logged her every minute. Solid.
And Ray, the delivery guy, signed for a box next door at 4:02.
lines.say: And Ray, the delivery guy, signed for a box next door at four oh-two.

lines.text: Ray was close. Too close. Hale liked him for it.
Until he zoomed in on that selfie.
Behind Jax: the old pier clock. Reading 9:10.
lines.say: Behind Jax: the old pier clock. Reading nine ten.

lines.text: That photo was shot in the morning. Posted hours later.
At 4 PM, Jax was right here. With a crowbar.
lines.say: At four P.M., Jax was right here. With a crowbar.

lines.text: And Ray? He really was just delivering a cake.
Case closed. So... did you check the clock?
